services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Classic Car Museum of St. Augustine offers fun and educational tours and programming for groups of all ages and is a great visit for corporate groups, schools groups, senior groups, and large and small bus tours which can be catered to any group and their needs. Group tours of the Museum are available by reservation year round, Tuesday through Friday, and can be scheduled between 10 am and 3 pm. The Museum offers an enjoyable and informative tour of the Museum with in depth discussions on the automobiles and the history of the automobile’s effect on America. The tours range from 45 minutes to an hour, and each one includes a guided tour of the current exhibit and permanent collection.
